**C. phosphocreatine stores.** The ATP already in muscle is used up within a fraction of a second, and phosphocreatine rapidly regenerates it, so it is the main initial source for very high force contractions lasting 1–2 seconds. The team note that glycolysis must supply the first energy is wrong: glycolysis is too slow to start and kicks in later, after the phosphocreatine system.

CONFIDENCE: 66
